title: While Loop
concept: A while loop repeats a block of code as long as a condition remains true.
why: Loops are one of programming's superpowers — they let you repeat actions without copying code, handling any number of repetitions.
tips: The loop body MUST change something that eventually makes the condition false
If the condition is false at the start, the body never runs — that's OK!
Use `var` for variables that need to change inside a loop
Think of while as 'keep doing this while this is true'
common_mistakes: Infinite loop: forgetting to update the counter variable
Off-by-one: using `<` when you mean `<=` (or vice versa)
Starting the counter at the wrong value
Making the condition ALWAYS false so the loop never runs
